daily.title: Prime Minister defends social media reforms amid US backlash
daily.summary: Anthony Albanese has pushed back against the Trump administration's "censorship" criticism of Australia's draft digital duty of care laws, as the US president rejects a push from Australia and other countries to impose AI safeguards.

daily.title: Breaking: Royal commission probing construction sector corruption in Victoria opens
daily.summary: The first open hearing of Victoria's construction sector royal commission has begun in the Melbourne Magistrates' Court.

daily.title: One-time champion boxer suspected to be key player in tobacco wars
daily.summary: Khalid Baker has fought to clear his name since being released in 2018 after being jailed for murder. Court documents now allege that Baker has run illicit tobacco stores with a member of one of the nation's most prominent organised crime families.

daily.title: How a controversial scheme will fund Australia's largest koala park
daily.summary: Experts, conservationists and politicians are divided on using carbon credits to help fund the Great Koala National Park.

daily.title: 'Flying mullet' Browning announces athletics retirement
daily.summary: Two-time Olympian Rohan Browning reflects on the moment that changed his life, as he calls time on his athletics career.

daily.title: Three teens arrested after alleged police stabbing, assault on security guard
daily.summary: A 14-year-old girl allegedly stabbed a police officer before being tasered and arrested at the scene In Darwin city yesterday, along with two other youths aged 16 and 13.

daily.title: Six-year-old solves Rubik's Cube in record 4.27 seconds
daily.summary: A six-year-old Chinese girl has set a world record after solving a Rubik's Cube in an average of 4.27 seconds.

daily.title: Schools trial AI leak detection technology to save water
daily.summary: The NSW government says about 20 per cent of the 2 million megalitres of water used by schools is lost to leaks every year.

daily.title: Cattle worth over half-a-million dollars reported missing at outback station
daily.summary: Rural crime investigators are trying to establish the whereabouts of over 200 head of cattle in outback NSW.

daily.title: Mary Fowler's Man City score controversial goal with flare burning on pitch
daily.summary: Bayern Munich players take issue as Manchester City scores a crucial goal in their Women's Champions League clash as a flare sends purple smoke billowing nearby.

daily.title: Banned Swans to make first public appearance since Pullman Hotel scandal
daily.summary: The five Sydney Swans players banned for breaching club standards return to Moore Park for the first time since the scandal occurred.

daily.title: Hacking group purports to have stolen FBI data in cyber attack
daily.summary: The digital extortion group known as ShinyHunters says it has stolen data about almost all of the FBI's current and former employees in an act of revenge against the organisation.

daily.title: Children in 'birthplace' of Mary Poppins mark coming-of-age ritual
daily.summary: Each equinox, children in the town considered the birthplace of Mary Poppins take part in a coming-of-age ceremony by rotating a statue of the beloved literary figure.

daily.title: Tones And I reveals why she turned down NRL grand final
daily.summary: Tones And I has broken her silence after the NRL declared it will forego a grand final tradition of pre-match entertainment.

daily.title: Record sheep prices see farmers turn crop paddocks over to stock
daily.summary: From record-breaking ewe prices in the Riverina to empty paddocks in the state's north and hay deliveries on the South Coast, NSW farmers are navigating an uneven season.

daily.title: Fremantle fans go to great lengths to see their team play at the MCG
daily.summary: A purple army of diehard Fremantle Dockers supporters is heading east and crossing the Nullarbor for Saturday's AFL grand final against the Lions in Melbourne.

daily.title: Cautious farmers embrace renewable energy to boost income streams
daily.summary: Farmers sign up to renewable projects on their land to diversify income, but large-scale projects and transmission lines remain sticking points.

daily.title: Dead humpback whale towed off Sunshine Coast beach
daily.summary: Authorities are towing the dead juvenile whale, which washed ashore at a popular beach, almost 40 kilometres out to sea.

daily.title: Girl killed and woman in serious condition after two-vehicle collision in Moana
daily.summary: A girl has died and two other people have been hospitalised following a car crash south of Adelaide last night.

daily.title: Live: Myer posts $276m annual loss on 'weak' consumer spending, ASX set to rise
daily.summary: Department store chain Myer reports a full-year loss of $276 million amid a "material downturn" in consumer sentiment. The ASX is set for a modest gain. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

daily.title: Live: PM responds to criticism of algorithm legislation
daily.summary: Anthony Albanese responds to criticisms of Australia's plan to allow people to opt out of the social media algorithm. Follow live.

daily.title: Search for Nannup Four begins as parents cross country to join volunteers
daily.summary: A group of volunteers will begin scouring bushland in Western Australia's South West in a bid for answers to the decades-old missing persons case.

daily.title: Why the AFL tribunal upheld Neale's grand final ban
daily.summary: The tribunal says it had reason not to overturn Lachie Neale's appeal. Now the AFL world waits to hear whether the Lions will launch an appeal.

daily.title: No evidence of a 'wage-price spiral' in Australia
daily.summary: There is no evidence of runaway wage growth emerging in Australia, RBA board member Iain Ross says.

daily.title: Federal government urged not to let fire ant eradication funding lapse
daily.summary: State agriculture ministers met in Canberra on Friday, where they noted fire ant eradication remained "technically feasible, cost beneficial and in the national interest".

developing.title: Live: ASX recovers from three-month low, surging oil prices drag Wall Street lower
developing.summary: The Australian share market has risen slightly, though is still trading near its lowest level since mid-June. Wall Street extended its sell-off as oil prices spiked on further signs of disruption in Saudi Arabian crude supplies. Follow live.

developing.title: Live: Burke to unveil Labor's revamped migration policy tomorrow after delay
developing.summary: Tony Burke will announce Labor's highly anticipated migration overhaul tomorrow, a month after he was forced to postpone a planned address. Follow live.

developing.title: Breaking: Emergency warning for fire at Blackmore, west of Berry Springs
developing.summary: Bushfires Northern Territory have issued an emergency warning for a fire at Stockwell Road in Blackmore, west of Berry Springs.

developing.title: Breaking: Olympic authorities sign off on controversial rowing and canoeing venue
developing.summary: The Fitzroy River in Rockhampton will host the events despite concerns over its current, length and crocodile inhabitants.

developing.title: Live: RBA more likely to raise rates as US Federal Reserve lifts to 4pc
developing.summary: Markets are pricing in a nearly 90 per cent chance of Australia's reserve bank lifting interest rates in September following the US Federal Reserve's decision to hike rates.

developing.title: Live: Labor folds to pressure, scraps $5,000 veterans allied health cap
developing.summary: The federal government has bowed to pressure and scrapped its proposed $5,000 veteran allied health cap announced in this year's federal budget. Follow live.

developing.title: Live: Qantas seeks to avert freight ground crew strikes
developing.summary: Qantas is heading to the Fair Work Commission as hundreds of ground workers plan strikes next week. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

developing.title: Live: Minister won't say if migration shake-up has undergone economic modelling
developing.summary: Amanda Rishworth has sidestepped questions about whether the government has undertaken economic modelling of its migration changes. Follow live.
